items.name: kit-fields
items.title: Form field schemas
items.description: Zod field schemas with the QA-PREVENTION rules built in: trim, lowercased email, untrimmed password, 4-digit year, bounded quantity.

items.name: kit-form
items.title: useKitForm
items.description: react-hook-form + zod with the two validation modes: on submit, or live with a delay before errors show.

items.name: kit-submit-guard
items.title: useSubmitGuard
items.description: Blocks double submit synchronously and carries one idempotency key per operation to the server.
